title: Extension of scalars of acyclic K-flat complexes
statement: Let (C,J) be a site, O and O' sheaves of commutative rings and phi: O → O' a morphism. Let E be an additive functor on their sheaf-module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with objects and maps (including equality transports) given by extension of scalars [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. If K is an acyclic [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules], K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] cochain complex of O-modules, then the termwise complex E(K) is acyclic as an O'-module complex. This is an object-level acyclicity assertion; no map between K-flat complexes is part of its statement.

source.place: Tags 06YT and 06YY; cone reformulation of quasi-isomorphism preservation

proof.text: Apply lem-pur-acyclic-kflat-tensor-arbitrary to K and each test complex F. This proves the universal tensor-acyclicity premise of lem-pur-change-of-rings-tensor-acyclic. Apply the latter with φ, E, h and hm to conclude that E(K) is acyclic.
